body.prompt: Create a responsive Navbar component using CSS Modules (.module.css). MUST use named export 'export const Navbar = ...'. MUST define a TypeScript 'interface' explicitly declaring ': string' for logo or title props and ': boolean' for menu states. MUST use a semantic '<nav>' element. MUST include 'aria-label' and 'role="navigation"' on the root nav element. MUST support keyboard accessibility using 'tabIndex' and 'aria-expanded' for the mobile menu toggle. MUST include '@media' queries for responsive navigation and mobile menu behavior. MUST NOT use 'any' or inline 'style={{...}}' or Tailwind. Support navigation links and Remix Icons if appropriate.
